name: K&S Corporation Limited
summary: K&S Corporation Limited provides transport and logistics solutions in Australia and New Zealand. The company operates through three segments: Australian Transport, Fuels, and New Zealand Transport. It offers road, rail, and coastal sea forwarding for full truck and break bulk loads, including export packing, wharf lodgement, and delivery of integrated supply chain and system solutions; remote, regional, and metro bulk fuel, as well as oil and gas transportation and distribution services; and dry and liquid bulk transportation services for mining, sugar, cement, and fertilizer industries.
